title: Russian officials studying UFOs

tellings.quote: And there have been other Russian officials that come out and say, "Yeah, we we've got people studying the UFO questions."

plain: Russian officials have said publicly, the claim goes, that Russia has people studying the UFO question. Robert Salas, a former Air Force missile officer who says a UFO shut down ten nuclear missiles at his base, tells Michels this without naming the officials, as a sign that it is not only America taking the matter seriously.
